TEST FIXTURE. A resident of Surf City, New Jersey, filmed a small shark swimming across a flooded street after a coastal storm pushed bay water over the road on Tuesday, according to local police.

Police said the animal, which appeared to be about 3 feet long, made its way back toward the bay as the water receded. No one was hurt.

A marine biologist who reviewed the video told local reporters the fish was most likely a young sandbar shark, a species common in the bay during late summer.
